entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well then—let's try to sort through[n]this situation.
Why are you here?
What's happening?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That seems as good a place to begin[n]as any.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: At the end of last year, I turned myself[n]in to the police as the perpetrator of the[n]serial psychotic breakdown incidents.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Your memory of this is still intact,[n]correct?
Yeah.
But... how are you alive?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Ah, yes...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So, my final enemy is a puppet version[n]of myself...
entries.uk: Отже, мій останній ворог — маріонеткова[n]версія мене самого...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: So, my final enemy is a puppet version[n]of myself...
entries.uk: Отже, мій останній ворог — маріонеткова[n]версія мене самого...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Not bad.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We have greater concerns right now. In[n]fact, I'm a bit offended you think so little[n]of me that you expected me to be dead.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Perhaps the most confusing part of[n]my story comes post-detainment.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Obviously, I was thoroughly interrogated[n]about my involvement in Shido's case...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But for some reason, after questioning,[n]I was suddenly released. No explanation[n]whatsoever.
That's too weird.
They let you walk?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I agree. No matter how one attempts to[n]rationalize it, my release is extremely[n]unusual.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Yes, I was acquitted of all charges.[n]It's absolutely preposterous.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: More than that—it should be impossible[n]for them to release a confessing suspect[n]after only a brief interrogation...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But, what's even more unbelievable[n]to me is...
Wakaba.
Morgana.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That's right.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That is indeed quite strange, but what's[n]even more abnormal is...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Wakaba Isshiki.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I can't believe she's been brought back[n]to life...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: For the time being, you seem to be[n]the only one who's still in their right[n]frame of mind.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I should get to the point.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...Let's make a deal.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: What say we join forces on this?
What would we do?
I can't trust you.
Let me think about it.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I want to investigate what exactly is[n]happening here.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm fairly certain you wish to find out[n]the same thing, no?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, I can understand that...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: But considering what's going on, I think[n]it's best to put aside personal grudges[n]and work together on this.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You know, that's uncharacteristically[n]cautious of you. I don't believe we have[n]the time for such an approach here.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: For the time being, you and I share[n]the same goal.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: To solve this problem, don't you agree[n]that it'd be safer for us to partner up?
He's right about the need for teamwork[n]to deal with this bizarre situation...
It may be best to work[n]with Akechi on this...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Have you made up your mind?
I guess I don't have a choice.
What do you need me to do?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Allow me to remind you that we are[n]equals in this endeavor, understand?[n]...Anyway, let's get to the matter at hand.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: First, I need information.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Can you tell me what happened after...[n]parting ways with me in Shido's Palace?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...I see.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Though some abnormalities appeared[n]immediately, the most glaring ones[n]arrived after the new year...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: And all of the Phantom Thieves, with you[n]as the sole exception, are living in this[n]altered reality without even realizing it...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Go ahead.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Senpai!? It's Yoshizawa!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I'm in Odaiba right now, and... uh...
Calm down.
What's happened?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Um, I don't really understand what[n]I'm seeing, but I'm just going to describe[n]it to you...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It's that building...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It's really faint, but I can see that "Palace"[n]thing that Morgana-senpai mentioned[n]a while ago!

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: [lName]-senpai, I know this is sudden,[n]but... Could you come to Odaiba right[n]away?
I'll be on my way.
Wait for me there.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I understand. I'll see you soon!

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: That was Yoshizawa-san's voice,[n]wasn't it?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I believe I heard her say the word[n]"Palace."
I guess she's spotted one.
You're just hearing things.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Despite not being in the Metaverse?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...Do you even understand what the word[n]"cooperate" means?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: You're planning to meet up with[n]Yoshizawa-san, right?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'll join you—we're all but guaranteed[n]to find a clue there.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Now that we've made ourselves a new[n]deal, you wouldn't turn me down,[n]would you?
